description: A slow, hands-on learner with a little Spanish asks what a word means: the answer still explains the word, in short steps, and invites him to try something.

request.greek: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν
request.english: And we know that all things work together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
request.question: What does ἀγαπῶσιν mean here?

learner_profile.background: Two years of Spanish at school, no Greek
learner_profile.why: To read John with my grandson
